baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus word 1 is an imperative of و ل ي governed by عنهم, while word 5 is a negated passive predicate from ل و م.
baseline_models.mechanism: The command establishes a relational boundary, and the negated blame predicate removes culpability from obeying it. Withdrawal is therefore authorized rather than negligent abandonment.

activation_trace.role: Withdrawal and turning aside supply the commanded disengagement from the addressed group.
Deserved reproach supplies the liability category canceled by the focus negation.

changed_reading.before: Continued confrontation appears obligatory, so leaving might look blameworthy.
changed_reading.after: The messenger may withdraw from their refusal, and this withdrawal itself carries no blame.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The و ل ي imperative is paired with a complement of separation, activating both the root's nearness and withdrawal branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: The root first supplies adjacency without an interval, then its withdrawal branch and the separating complement reverse that adjacency. The verse marks the deliberate end of close engagement, not mere bodily rotation.

activation_trace.role: Uninterrupted nearness supplies the prior relational adjacency that the command reverses.
Turning away supplies the active conversion of adjacency into distance.
Reproach supplies the moral risk that is explicitly excluded from the new boundary.

changed_reading.before: The imperative denotes a simple turn of the body or attention.
changed_reading.after: The imperative deliberately reverses sustained proximity and closes an unproductive relational interval without moral fault.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus imperative can hold together the و ل ي branches of taking charge and withdrawing, under an explicit negation of blame.
baseline_models.mechanism: Withdrawal from them can also mean relinquishing practical oversight of their response. The messenger is released from acting as guardian or manager of an outcome he cannot own.

activation_trace.role: Taking charge of an affair supplies the managerial responsibility from which the command releases the messenger.
Withdrawal supplies the act that ends continued management of their response.
Blame supplies the performance liability that the negation removes.

changed_reading.before: The verse only permits the messenger to avert attention.
changed_reading.after: The verse releases the messenger from managerial ownership of whether the audience responds.

context_deltas.mechanism: The window frames commissioned transmission, compelling warrant, disclosure, and repeated warning before the focus command. Negated blame therefore reads as discharge after communication has been made inspectable, not permission to omit it.

activation_trace.role: Withdrawal supplies the terminal boundary after the warning sequence.
Reproach supplies the liability removed once the commissioned communication has been discharged.
Messenger and message supply the commissioned transmission whose completion precedes release.
Compelling proof supplies authoritative warrant rather than unsupported assertion.
Disclosure and emergence into view make the prior communication publicly manifest.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the notice repeatedly delivered before withdrawal.

structural_cues: 51:38 opens with dispatch and manifest authority; 51:50-51 repeat the first-person clear-warning formula before 51:54.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies commission, warrant, disclosure, and warning; I infer a liability boundary after delivery. A live alternative is that the sequence offers consolation without defining a procedural threshold.

changed_reading.before: Turn away simply because persuasion has failed.
changed_reading.after: Turn away because the commissioned warning has been made clear; responsibility for its reception no longer attaches to the messenger.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Pharaoh sequence and the focus reuse the roots of turning and blame with opposite polarity. Pharaoh turns away while relying on a strong support and ends blameworthy; the messenger is commanded to turn away and is declared unblamed.

activation_trace.role: Withdrawal supplies the focus action whose moral polarity must be distinguished from Pharaoh's.
Deserved reproach supplies the category explicitly denied of the messenger.
Pharaoh's turning away supplies the formally matching but culpable counterpart.
A strong side used for support supplies the power base behind Pharaoh's refusal.
Culpable reproach supplies the positive verdict on Pharaoh that the focus negates for the messenger.

structural_cues: 51:39-40 place a turning-away form and a positive blame predicate in one episode; 51:54 repeats the turn while negating blame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated roots, opposite blame polarity, and Pharaoh's support; I infer a deliberate moral mirror. The live alternative is a local contrast with no broader role reversal.

changed_reading.before: The verse grants generic permission to disengage.
changed_reading.after: The verse reverses Pharaoh's pattern: outwardly similar withdrawal becomes obedient and blameless because culpable refusal already belongs to the other side.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same paired accusations recur across separated messenger episodes. The question of mutual transmission is answered by excess beyond the limit, relocating the recurrence from messenger defect to a self-reproducing audience pattern.

activation_trace.role: Withdrawal supplies disengagement from a recurrent accusation pattern rather than from a single failed exchange.
Reproach supplies the misallocated liability that the focus returns to the accusing pattern.
Attributing what is not so supplies the mechanism of recurrent misclassification.
Diversion and deception supply one pole of the accusation used to dismiss disclosure.
Veiling of intellect supplies the second pole of the repeated dismissal.
Mutual transmission of counsel supplies the proposed inherited-script mechanism.
Exceeding the limit in disobedience supplies the packet's alternative cause of the recurring script.

structural_cues: 51:39 and 51:52 repeat the same binary accusation; 51:53 immediately tests transmission and then supplies a shared disposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrence, a transmission question, and a transgression diagnosis; I infer a self-reproducing attributional script whose persistence is not messenger failure. A live alternative is simple narrative repetition.

changed_reading.before: Withdraw from the present group after their rejection.
changed_reading.after: Withdraw from a recurrent accusation script whose cross-generational persistence diagnoses its users, not the messenger.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeatedly fixes respite and blocks haste. The focus blame root also carries a waiting branch, allowing a secondary reading in which withdrawal releases the messenger from forcing the chronology of response or consequence.

activation_trace.role: Withdrawal supplies relinquishment of active pressure on the outcome.
Tarrying and waiting supply a secondary temporal layer beneath the controlling blame sense.
Extended preservation for enjoyment supplies an allotted interval before consequence.
Assigning a known time supplies a chronology not controlled by the messenger.
Waiting and granting respite supply delayed realization within the historical sequence.
Acceleration supplies the pressure explicitly prohibited near the window's close.

structural_cues: 51:43 sets enjoyment until a time, while 51:59 closes with a prohibition on seeking haste.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies allotted respite and prohibited acceleration; I infer that the messenger may stop forcing resolution. A live alternative confines all timing language to the judged communities and leaves 51:54 purely relational.

changed_reading.before: Withdrawal follows a failed warning and awaits no further dimension.
changed_reading.after: Withdrawal also releases the messenger from demanding immediate resolution; delay in response or consequence is not his culpability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier imperative supplies an explicit movement toward God, while the focus supplies movement away from them. The two vectors make withdrawal an oriented transfer of allegiance rather than an empty retreat.

activation_trace.role: Turning the face toward a destination supplies the positive orientation latent within the focus root.
Turning away supplies the negative vector explicitly directed from the resistant group.
Flight supplies urgent directional movement rather than passive cessation.
The worshipped one supplies the destination that gives the away-movement positive orientation.

structural_cues: 51:50 gives an explicit destination with إلى; 51:54 gives an explicit point of departure with عنهم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposite prepositional vectors in imperatives addressed to different subjects; I transfer their directional logic to the focus. A live alternative keeps the audience's flight and the messenger's withdrawal entirely separate.

changed_reading.before: The messenger simply steps back from them.
changed_reading.after: The away-movement is a reorientation of allegiance toward God, not withdrawal into vacancy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah immediately commands reminder and names the group that benefits. Withdrawal therefore changes mode and effective audience: unproductive contention ends, while beneficial reminder continues where trust can receive it.

activation_trace.role: Withdrawal supplies cessation of the unproductive engagement named in the focus.
Unbroken succession supplies adjacent phases in which withdrawal is followed by another communicative act.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies the continuing communicative act after withdrawal.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the criterion for continuing the reminder.
Trusting assent supplies the receptive audience for whom reminder remains effective.

structural_cues: The next ayah begins with another imperative and explicitly identifies believers as the beneficiaries of reminder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent commands and a named beneficiary; I infer a shift of mode or audience rather than total silence. A live alternative reads the commands as temporal alternation without audience partition.

changed_reading.before: Turn away means cease addressing everyone.
changed_reading.after: Leave blame-producing contention with the resistant group while preserving reminder wherever trusting reception makes it beneficial.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus sequence assigns creation, the worship purpose, non-need, provision, and sufficient power to God. This strengthens the focus release from caretaking: the messenger transmits and reminds but does not create, provision, or administratively produce the audience's worship-response.

activation_trace.role: Taking charge of an affair supplies the managerial role denied to the messenger over audience response.
Reproach supplies the performance liability removed from that non-managerial role.
Bringing creation into being assigns the audience's existence to divine agency.
Submissive worship supplies the purpose whose realization the messenger does not manufacture.
Will and desire supply the demand axis that the verse twice negates toward the audience.
Apportioned provision assigns sustaining agency to God rather than messenger or audience.
Concentrated strength supplies sufficient divine capacity behind purpose and provision.

structural_cues: 51:56 states the creation-purpose relation; 51:57 negates any requested provision or feeding; 51:58 identifies the provider and strength.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine creation, purpose, non-need, provision, and power; I infer that producing response is outside messenger ownership. A live alternative treats these verses as theology with no direct allocation of messenger responsibility.

changed_reading.before: The messenger may stop trying to persuade this audience.
changed_reading.after: The messenger is released from governing or provisioning their worship-response because purpose and sustaining agency belong to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence apportions wrongdoers a share matching their companions and forbids haste. Their historical consequence remains their assigned burden and timing; it does not migrate into messenger blame.

activation_trace.role: Withdrawal supplies the messenger's refusal to carry or accelerate the audience's assigned outcome.
Reproach supplies the burden that is not transferred from wrongdoers to messenger.
A person's share or allotment supplies consequence as their assigned portion.
Likeness supplies the matching relation between the present wrongdoers and prior counterparts.
Companionship supplies the historical cohort with whom their portion is grouped.
Acceleration supplies the attempt to force distribution that the verse prohibits.

structural_cues: 51:59 assigns the wrongdoers a matching portion and immediately blocks demands for haste.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an apportioned analogue and prohibited haste; I infer that burden and timing remain with the offenders. A live alternative treats the portion solely as a punishment image without reallocating responsibility.

changed_reading.before: The messenger is merely unblamed for withdrawing.
changed_reading.after: Their due remains assigned to their historical cohort; neither its burden nor its timing transfers to the messenger.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the focus blame root's non-dominant split mapping and is form-distant. It remains anchored at focus word 5 and answers the repeated madness accusation through a packet-supplied branch. Downstream prose must retain blamelessness as the controlling sense and label this only as a secondary resonance, never as a translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 5 has a dominant blame inventory and a split-root branch involving a touch of madness; the preceding accusation refrain supplies the matching context.

activation_trace.role: Deserved reproach preserves the controlling surface acquittal from blame.
A touch of madness supplies a split-root echo under the focus predicate rather than its direct gloss.
Veiling of intellect by madness supplies the explicit allegation that the secondary echo counters.

changed_reading.before: The focus acquits the messenger only of culpability.
changed_reading.after: The focus acquits him of culpability while a contained split-root echo also refuses to validate the recurring madness label.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a livestock-separation branch is materially remote from the imperative's ordinary syntax. It remains anchored in the focus و ل ي inventory, receives a second livestock cue in 51:48, and fits the beneficiary distinction in 51:55. Downstream prose should present it only as a pastoral analogy for audience sorting, not as lexical meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A branch under the focus و ل ي root depicts separating smaller livestock from larger stock until they become tractable; the next command preserves reminder for a receptive group.

activation_trace.role: Separating young stock from larger animals supplies a pastoral sorting image for differentiated engagement.
Small livestock supply a second material cue that activates the focus branch's pastoral domain.
Benefit supplies the functional test for where continued communicative care is retained.
Trusting assent supplies the receptive cohort distinguished from those left in resistance.

changed_reading.before: The command abandons the addressed group wholesale.
changed_reading.after: As a contained pastoral analogy, the command sorts resistant engagement away while continuing formative reminder where receptivity exists.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines a rare rain branch of the focus root with a non-dominant split mapping from 51:47. It remains packet-anchored through the exact sequence of first marking rain, follow-up rain, reminder, and provisioning rain. Downstream prose must call it a meteorological material analogy, not a lexical rendering of the imperative.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A focus و ل ي branch names rain that follows the first marking rain, making the apparent withdrawal-reminder tension available as a staged watering sequence.

activation_trace.role: Rain following the first seasonal marking rain supplies a sequence image for renewed address after withdrawal.
The first rain that marks earth with growth supplies the initial shower through the packet's split mapping.
Reminder supplies the renewed communicative watering that follows apparent cessation.
Rain descending as provision keeps the material image tied to beneficial giving.

changed_reading.before: 51:54 ends address and 51:55 restarts it without an internal relation.
changed_reading.after: As a contained rain analogy, an initial address marks the ground, withdrawal intervenes, and reminder follows as a second beneficial watering of receptive soil.

strongest_changes: The Pharaoh episode turns the focus into a moral mirror: his supported withdrawal is blameworthy, while the messenger's commanded withdrawal is explicitly unblamed.
Commission, manifest warrant, and repeated warning recast the focus as discharge after completed communication rather than permission to omit communication.
The immediate reminder command revises total abandonment into cessation of futile contention with continued benefit-oriented address to believers.
The post-focus purpose and provision sequence removes managerial ownership of audience response from the messenger.
summary.what_was_special: Exact root reversal, repeated accusation syntax, and the abrupt withdrawal-reminder sequence carried the strongest changes. Split-root inventories also exposed contained madness, pastoral sorting, and following-rain resonances that a conservative synthesis would likely erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus alone does not decide whether withdrawal is temporary, audience-selective, or a permanent end to direct contention.
The caretaking and outcome-timing readings are coherent but depend on secondary branches beyond the imperative's ordinary withdrawal sense.
The split-root and material outliers are packet-grounded resonances, not lexical translations, and should remain explicitly qualified.
